# MAAK | معك للسفر والسياحة

> MAAK is a travel services brand offering travel enquiries and assistance through direct contact. The website provides information; it does not complete bookings online.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://maaktravel.vercel.app/): Overview of MAAK travel services.
- [Services](https://maaktravel.vercel.app/services): Browse available travel services.
- [About MAAK](https://maaktravel.vercel.app/about): Learn about the company.
- [Contact MAAK](https://maaktravel.vercel.app/contact): Contact the team about a travel enquiry.

## Travel services

- [Flight bookings](https://maaktravel.vercel.app/flights): Enquiries about routes, destinations, and flight booking steps.
- [Hotel reservations](https://maaktravel.vercel.app/hotels): Enquiries about accommodation options.
- [Car rental and transport](https://maaktravel.vercel.app/car-rental): Enquiries about car rental and transport.
- [Tourism and trips](https://maaktravel.vercel.app/tourism): Travel planning and trip-related enquiries.
- [Medical travel](https://maaktravel.vercel.app/medical-tourism): Coordination enquiries for medical travel.
- [Egypt security clearance](https://maaktravel.vercel.app/security-clearance-egypt): Enquiries about requirements and procedures.
- [Hajj and Umrah](https://maaktravel.vercel.app/umrah): Enquiries about pilgrimage travel arrangements.
- [Bus tickets and ground transport](https://maaktravel.vercel.app/transport): Enquiries about local and international ground transport.
- [Real estate services](https://maaktravel.vercel.app/real-estate): Enquiries about property-related services.

## Contact and limitations

- Enquiries are handled directly through the contact options provided on the website, including WhatsApp.
- Prices, availability, eligibility, and final booking conditions must be confirmed directly with MAAK and the relevant providers.
- This website does not currently expose a public AI agent, MCP server, or machine-callable booking API.
